articles.title: AI uncovers hidden bladder cancer warning signs years before diagnosis
articles.description: Scientists have developed an AI tool that can uncover hidden warning signs of bladder cancer up to five years before diagnosis, identifying 85% of cases in a major study involving nearly 70,000 patients. By revealing subtle patterns that conventional screening misses, the technology could help doctors detect cancer earlier and spare patients unnecessary invasive procedures.

articles.title: Claude Second Brain: Build a Memory That Can Prove What It Knows
articles.description: How to build an evidence-backed knowledge system that tracks what changed, why, and when — instead of just storing information.Most AI second brains solve the wrong problem. They help you save information, but they do not help you figure out whether that information is still true. Imagine researching a tool in January, changing your mind in March, and asking your AI for advice in June. It retrieves the original note, skips the later decision, and confidently recommends the thing you already...
